id.description: Globally unique identifier for this group.

ifsId.description: IFS system identifier for this Group.

entityType.description: IFS entity category/type for this group.

basedOn.description: Id of the object this object is derived from.

entityDocumentationUrl.description: URL for documentation about this entity.

description.description: Purpose and context of this group.

members.description: Members directly belonging to this group. Membership alone does not grant delegated authority.

organizations.description: Organizations directly belonging to this group. Inclusion alone does not grant delegated authority.

groups.description: Subgroups directly belonging to this group. Containment alone does not grant delegated authority or imply transitive membership.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when this group record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when this group record was last updated.
